title: Problems after changing libre sensor
symptom: After changing the Libre sensor and battery in Blucon, no data (except battery level and sensor age) appears in the app. The log is filled with 'received historic data, m_block_number=' for hours, and no additional window with 4 steps and calibration request appeared after sensor change.
fix: Complete app removal and reinstallation resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Everything fine since complete app removing and installing again.
